title.narrative: and % of targeted CSOs demonstrating effective engagement of at least 2 out the following: (1) youth, (2) data and (3) digital technologies, and (4) social innovation by the end of the project

description.narrative: CSOs are considered those that are legally registered nongovernmental, noncommercial organisation in the Republic of Tajikistan with at least 2 permanent staff members in Dushanbe, and at least one district in Khatlon and DRS.Effective engagement would mean having operationalized in their strategies/operations/initiatives at least two of the following groups: youth, data, digital technologies, and social innovations. This should be measured by the final evaluators through observation method and interviews through a visist to sampled CSOs at the edn of the project and observe if two of the mentioned criteria are in placeExample social innovation: CSO implements new approaches, ideas, or solutions that address social challenges more effectively. We can think of: introducing new models of actions/campagins/activities, creating partnerships, new strategies, new concepts, new services etc. taht aim to have a positive social change.

description.narrative: Evidence based policies means the policies that are defined by the conducted Political Economy Analysis report.
